hooks.command: [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists. Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files."}}' || true

p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); echo "$p" | grep -qE 'server/data/library\.db' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"library.db is 24GB on a 2GB box. Direct edits via Write/Edit will corrupt it. Use sqlite3 CLI, scripts/, or a server route instead."}}' || true

git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); case "$branch" in main|master|develop|HEAD) exit 0 ;; esac; if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then exit 0; fi; git add -u; if git diff --cached --quiet; then exit 0; fi; git commit -m "auto: claude $(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M:%S)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; (git pull --rebase --autostash && git push) >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 0
